channel.title: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (London) Service Status
channel.generator: AWS Service Health Dashboard RSS Generator
channel.description: Receive the most recent update for events affecting the overall availability of Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud in London.

item.title: Increased API Error Rates
item.description:
We are investigating increased API error rates & latencies for the RunInstances API in the EU-WEST-2 Region.

Existing instances are not affected.

item.title: Informational message: Scheduled network maintenance
item.description: We will perform maintenance on networking devices in a single Availability Zone.

item.title: Service is operating normally: [RESOLVED] Instance connectivity
item.description: Between 9:05 AM and 10:10 AM PDT some instances lost connectivity. The issue has been resolved & the service is operating normally.
